cards.text: Tell the group a fact about yourself that sounds like a lie.
Name three things you and the person to your left have in common.
Share the most unusual food combination you secretly enjoy.
Tell the group what you wanted to be when you were eight.
Name a movie or show everyone here should watch this week.
Share a skill you have that would surprise most people here.
Describe your ideal Saturday morning in three sentences.
Tell the group the last thing you Googled. Be honest.
What is the most recent compliment someone gave you?
Describe yourself using only the names of three animals.
Tell the group your go-to karaoke song, even if you'd never sing it.
What city would you move to tomorrow if you had to pick right now?
Share a hobby you've always wanted to try but never have.
What is one thing you are better at than you let on?
Describe the last stranger who made a good impression on you.
What is the most interesting thing within arm's reach of you right now?
Share the weirdest thing you've ever eaten.
What would the title of your autobiography be?
Tell the group something you believed as a child that turned out to be wrong.
Name a song that describes your current mood.
What is the most useful thing you know how to do?
Describe your morning routine in one sentence.
Tell the group the last book or article you actually finished.
Tell the group something you are genuinely proud of from this year.
What is one word your closest friend would use to describe you?
What would you like to be known or remembered for?
What sport would you compete in if you were in the Olympics?
What movie can you rewatch over and over again?
If you had 25 hours a day, how would you spend your extra time?
